why: Image 1 holds together as one quiet, empty room shot after hours: the warm pendant and globe light, the shadows thrown across the concrete floor, and the timber, upholstery and plaster all read cleanly, with no artefacts to give it away. Image 2 adds long-exposure 'patrons', but up close they are smooth, faceless mannequin smears (one has a solid body under a ghosted head), and the frame carries blotchy compression and denoise noise, so it reads as a doctored render rather than a real night in a real bar.
